Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 15 as introduced requires an annual transfer of $1.2 million from the 5% portion of the base amount of annual license taxes and registration fees deposited into the Public Road and Bridge Fund to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agencys (ALEA) Public Safety Fund beginning in fiscal year 2022, which codifies the current transfer amount established under an interagency agreement between the Alabama Department of Revenue (ADOR) and ALEA.  This agreement provides for the annual compensation of ten Revenue Enforcement Officers transferred from ADOR or ALEA pursuant to Act 2013-067.  The amount of this transfer for each fiscal year is shown in the table below:
2015
$517,356
2016
$1,200,000
2017
$1,200,000
2018
$1,200,000
2019
$1,200,000
2020
$1,200,000
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
